cases.goal: Implement a summary API. normalize(values) must retain finite numbers, ignore other values, and never mutate the input. label(count) must return item for 1 and items otherwise. summary(values) must return {count,total,label} using both helpers. Preserve ES module exports and handle empty input.
cases.check: node --check normalize.mjs && node --check label.mjs && node --check summary.mjs

tasks.title: Normalize numeric values
tasks.prompt: Implement normalize(values) in normalize.mjs. Retain finite numbers, ignore all other values, preserve order and input immutability.

tasks.title: Format the count label
tasks.prompt: Implement label(count) in label.mjs: item for 1, items otherwise.

tasks.title: Integrate and verify summary
tasks.prompt: Implement summary(values) in summary.mjs using normalize and label. Verify the complete original request including empty inputs and mutation. Correct only summary.mjs; report upstream defects as blockers.

cases.oracle: const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const {pathToFileURL} = require('node:url'); const path = require('node:path'); (async()=> { const base=process.argv[2]; const {normalize}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(base,'normalize.mjs'))); const {label}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(base,'label.mjs'))); const {summary}=await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(base,'summary.mjs'))); const input=[1,'2',NaN,Infinity,-3,null,0]; assert.deepEqual(normalize(input),[1,-3,0]); assert.equal(input.length,7); assert.equal(label(1),'item'); assert.equal(label(0),'items'); assert.deepEqual(summary(input),{count:3,total:-2,label:'items'}); assert.deepEqual(summary([]),{count:0,total:0,label:'items'}); assert.deepEqual(summary([4]),{count:1,total:4,label:'item'}); })().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exitCode=1});

cases.goal: Fix clamp(value, min, max). Return value when in range, the nearest boundary otherwise. Throw RangeError for min > max. Preserve the export and support negative values.

files.clamp.mjs: export function clamp(value, min, max) { return Math.min(min, Math.max(max, value)); }

tasks.title: Fix clamp boundaries
tasks.prompt: Fix clamp.mjs and check its boundary cases against the full request.
